rows.grounds: manner adverb referring to the previously described ritual procedure
causative optative expressing potential or prescribed action
human agent performing or commissioning the rite
qualifies the resulting destination as auspicious
state or goal attained as result of the rite

items.question: What meritorious destination does a mortal who commissions this ritual attain?
premises: A mortal may cause the previously described ritual to be performed.
Performing the described ritual in this manner is a meritorious act.
Meritorious ritual action yields a corresponding auspicious destination.
items.inference: Therefore, a mortal who causes this ritual to be performed attains a meritorious destination.
items.plain_english: Thus, whatever mortal causes this ritual to be performed attains a meritorious destination.
